brand_notes: Polk US lists all bookshelf models current (Reserve R100/R200, Signature Elite ES15/ES20, T15, Monitor XT15/XT20). Nominal impedance is not stated for ES/XT/Reserve ('compatible with 4- and 8-ohm outputs'); only T-Series info sheet rates T15 at 8 ohm. Measured minima for ES20 3.6, XT15/XT20 about 4.0, T15 about 4.1 ohm: all effectively 4 ohm designs. Design traits: Terylene dome tweeters, Dynamic Balance cones, budget price, 5-year warranty, Vietnam manufacture (tnt-audio XT15). XT15 listed under satellite/surround on Polk US.
takeaways: Good LW ±1.9 dB, minor DI discontinuity, low sens 84.4 dB, f3 77 Hz
THD ~0.5% at 86 dB; 2.5% at 96 dB (graph-read); compression <=2.4 dB at 102 dB
Maker only says 4/8-ohm compatible; manual min 4.1 Ω per TNT-Audio; measured ~4.0 Ω
TNT-Audio: open, articulate, strong bass for size
log_bullets: Impedance flag below-iec (4.0 Ω graph-read); no user reports ingested
